scope: Immutable unverified capture/receipt storage component only
prior_exposure: Factfinder authored W020 design and UUID/access/editor follow-up, and prior API/validator reviews. Implementation authored by different agent Factomaton sharing Adrian ownership. Not blinded, independent-owner or independent design confirmation.
findings: No blocking defect found in exact four-file storage increment and unchanged sidecar dependency. Receipt raw bytes and canonical metadata/digests are distinct; capture JSON reformatting retries canonically, equivalent receipt JSON with different raw bytes requires a distinct capture UUID.

Malformed capture/receipt and nested duplicate keys/nonportable numbers/oversize/expanded canonical metadata fail before database creation in tested cases. CLI bounds reads and catches validation/recursion/SQLite failures. Resource bounds are byte limits and Python recursion behavior, not a complete parser CPU/memory proof.

UUIDs/revision/full commit/timestamps are syntactically checked, not authenticated identity/history. Time ordering, currentness, ownership, actor authority, source-manifest correspondence and decision semantics are outside this component. Tool-shaped authenticated:true and imported errors never promote fixed unverified_import/unknown/unchecked/pending statuses.

SQLite insert-on-conflict plus equality comparison prevents this API from replacing an existing capture binding. Tested thread regressions and four independent CLI processes preserve one row. Changed bytes/metadata fail without changing original row; five-second SQLite lock failure produces CLI exit2 with no partial row.

Database file remains operator-controlled. Append-only describes application write behavior, not SQL-level restrictions, tamper-proof storage, signed provenance or a security boundary against arbitrary file/database writers. Canonical capture metadata and exact receipt bytes are retained; original formatting of the capture envelope is intentionally not retained.
